experiment: 2: SAE features as symbol-table bindings with lifetime and readers at the carrier
status: sealed before any showcase job; single seed
model: Qwen3-1.7B-Base bf16 eager CUDA (Beast, mrun, priority 70)
sae: Qwen-Scope SAE-Res-Qwen3-1.7B-Base-W32K-L0_50 (resid_post, k=50), layers 9..22 loaded; L19 checked against SAELens to_saelens() (strict load) active set; SAE.from_pretrained registry load attempted offline and its outcome recorded
panel: Run 1a base items (64; results/twohop-20261113/next/r1_items.json group=base), consumer M[answer (capital), donor answer] at the last row (the B1 map consumer)

predictions.L1: the top country feature's component carries >= 0.5 of the carrier's to_consumer on >= 40/64 base items; the error component <= 0.2 on >= 48/64
predictions.L2: at L20, removing the top country feature's component moves M by >= 0.5 of the whole-cell removal (cell zeroed) on the median item; the random component (matched norm) <= 0.15; the error component <= 0.2
predictions.L3: the lineage onset of the top country feature (decoder-cosine >= 0.7 chain, active at each layer) is at a median layer <= L12 (>= 6 layers before L18). Falsifier: onset within 2 layers of L17 (onset >= L15) on >= 40/64
predictions.L4: the feature-component removal is above the floor only inside L17..L21 (not at L15, L16, L22, L23) on >= 48/64 items
predictions.partition_falsifier: the component partition (sum of component shares = the float64 cell image's share; closure of components vs W_V^g(rho gamma h)) fails outside float64 rounding on any item -> B-a is wrong

operational_definitions.carrier: L20 KV6 at R_argmax (frozen B1 rule: argmax of the answer row's L20 h12+h13 attention over the span), mdb circuit_map.slot_rows
operational_definitions.components: mdb Binding.component over basis L(l-1) for cell L(l) KV6 at the carrier row: one component per active feature, decoder bias, error
operational_definitions.to_consumer: mdb component_table: sum_{h in group 6} p[h,r] c.W_O,h v_i at the native attention weights (exact direct share); 'carrier to_consumer' = the native cell's share
operational_definitions.country feature: an active feature whose component's content readout over the 57 panel countries (symbols.content through W_O of KV group 6 and gamma_F W_U) names the item's true country; the content ranking of a feature component is independent of its activation and rho, so this is a property of the feature at that cell; 'top' = the largest to_consumer among them; items with none count as failing L1
operational_definitions.random component: a uniformly drawn (seed 20261114) active feature whose content does not name the truth; its removal is rescaled to the top country component's norm
operational_definitions.floor: 2 bf16 spacings at the larger |logit| of (answer, foil) + the measured cell_sweep null_vs_stepped of that item
operational_definitions.L2 ratios: dM(arm)/dM(zero) per item at L20, median over items with a top country feature
operational_definitions.lineage: backward from the L19 top feature: at each layer l<19 the feature of basis l with the largest decoder cosine to the previous chain feature; onset = lowest layer such that every layer from it to L19 has cosine >= 0.7 and that feature active at the carrier row (L9 lowest examined: onset L9 is censored and reported as such)
operational_definitions.projection strip: the exact projection of the unit L19 decoder direction onto t<crow>.L<l>.h_out, l = 0..27 (reported, not judged)
operational_definitions.nulls: always-last-row cell (where the last span row differs from the carrier): its top country component share; random component share; error share

native_arms: per item one batched mdb cell_sweep (null arm per chunk) over L15..L23 x {top, random, error, zero}
deviation_from_memo: the memo's L15..L23 table is read from a native run (h at the carrier row is not in the 1a captures, only K/V); the lineage is examined L9..L19 so that L3's threshold (<= L12) is measurable
